claims.finding: Final OP7(a) assigns USD42,468,400 to active client peacekeeping budgets; OP7(b) assigns USD3,443,200 to specified mixed clients subject to approval in the2027programmebudget context. OP7(c) identifies USD5,157,200 staff-assessment income offsetting7(a). The separate calendar2027SPM USD3,259,100 remains retained and not freshly authenticated.
